Privacy Policy

Nabeeh · 23 October 2026

Privacy Policy Terms of Use Support العربية

This policy explains how Nabeeh handles your data. Your financial data stays on your device, and signing in is optional. If you sign in with Google we keep a copy in your account so it comes back on any device.

Who we are

Nabeeh is published by Nibras Tech (independent developer) (“we”). Privacy contact: nibras.tech.sa@gmail.com.

Your financial data: on your device, with an optional copy in your account

Your net salary, payday, monthly commitments, savings goals and the expenses you record are stored on your device. While you are not signed in we do not send them to our servers or to anyone else, and we cannot see them.

When you sign in with Google (optional, and required to subscribe) a copy of this data is saved to your account in Google’s Firebase service (Cloud Firestore). Only you can access it, and it is updated automatically with each change so it returns after you change or reset your device. You can delete the copy at any time in Settings, or sign out to stop syncing

When you export a report (PDF or CSV) the file is created on your device, and you decide whether and with whom to share it.

What we process

  • Payout schedule: the app reads a public schedule of salary and benefit payout dates from Google’s Firebase service (Cloud Firestore). It contains nothing about you, but any internet connection reveals your IP address and technical device information to the service, as needed to complete the connection.
  • Sign-in and backup: when you sign in with Google we receive your account ID, e-mail and name from Google and store a copy of your financial data (salary, commitments, goals, expenses and their notes) linked only to your account, used only to restore it for you.
  • Nabeeh Plus subscription: when you subscribe or restore purchases, the app sends our server the purchase token and product ID issued by Google Play, together with your Google account’s unique ID (through Firebase Authentication), so the subscription follows your account to any device. We verify the token with Google Play and store the subscription status and end date. We never receive your card details; payment is handled entirely by Google Play.
  • Reminders: scheduled on your device and never pass through a server.

We do not collect your name, email address, phone number, location or contacts, and we do not use behavioural analytics or tracking tools other than what the ad network described in the Advertising section collects.

Advertising

The free version shows ads through Google AdMob. AdMob and its partners may collect your device advertising ID, IP address and usage data to serve and measure ads and prevent fraud, under Google’s policies. You can reset your advertising ID or turn off ad personalisation in your device settings.

Where the law requires it (for example the European Economic Area) we ask for your consent through a Google consent form before showing ads, and you can change your choice later.

We do not share your financial data with the ad network. A Nabeeh Plus subscription removes ads.

How we use data

  • To run the app’s features.
  • To verify subscriptions and unlock Nabeeh Plus.
  • To show the up-to-date payout schedule.
  • To prevent abuse of subscriptions.

We do not sell your data.

Who processes data for us

We rely on Google services: Google Play (payments and subscriptions) and Firebase (database, sign-in and cloud functions). Their processing is governed by Google’s terms and policies.

Ads are served through Google AdMob.

Retention and deletion

  • App data on your device: deleted with “Reset account and start over” in Settings, or by uninstalling the app.
  • Copy saved in your account: deleted in Settings → “Delete my saved copy”, or by e-mailing nibras.tech.sa@gmail.com.
  • Subscription record on our server (purchase token, anonymous ID and subscription status): kept as long as necessary to provide the subscription and meet our accounting and legal obligations. To ask for deletion, email nibras.tech.sa@gmail.com with proof of purchase. Deleting it may switch off Nabeeh Plus for that account.

Security

Connections to cloud services use encrypted channels (HTTPS), and your local data is kept in the app’s protected storage on Android. No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, so we recommend protecting your device with a screen lock.

Children

The app is intended for adults and we do not knowingly collect data from children.

Your rights

You may ask what data we hold about you, and ask us to correct or delete it, in line with the laws that apply in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, including the Personal Data Protection Law. Email nibras.tech.sa@gmail.com and we will reply within a reasonable time.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy and will show the updated version in the app and on its web page with the effective date. This version is effective 23 October 2026.
